scope: Five new registry entries, the first Toledo entries ever for "Human Learning as Epistemic Architecture: A Method for Word Mapping, Life-Concept Graphs, Constraint Testing, and Corrigible Agency in the AI Age" (Yaoharee Lahtee, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22341297), which had zero entries despite being a foundational paper on human learning -- confirmed both by an earlier registry sweep and independently re-confirmed in this pass. The paper's own equation-extraction audit (registry/eq_22341297.json) already established it contains zero formal numbered equations; this pass read the full 51-page cached text directly (not a summary) and formalized six candidate claims, of which five survived a fresh TG-RFG-01 lookup as genuinely new (the sixth, an operator-distinction framing thesis, was judged too rhetorical/not symbol-ready and deliberately left unregistered). All five entries are anchored under EXISTING roots (EQ-015, weld) per this registry's own established convention that every root traces to a genesis_root.json anchor -- an initial draft proposed a brand-new 'HLEA' root, which was corrected before registration since a bare new root would have no such anchor, unlike the precedent this correction checked (BridgeCommute, which anchors to Genesis's own VI.6-BridgeCommute gate). New codes: EQ-015/M.18.v1 (Life-Concept Graph, a labeled directed graph), EQ-015/M.19.v1 (constraint-test status-transition function), EQ-015/H.55.v1 (Resistant Coherence, a four-condition AND-gate -- deliberately given no theorem, since a bare conjunction has none to honestly prove), EQ-015/H.56.v1 (corrigibility-loop vs. closure-loop two-branch automaton), weld/S.52.v1 (a yoked-control falsification condition, modelled over rationals per this workspace's readout-first discretion). All tiered Definition, all cite verbatim quotes from the source text in their own statements_history, all independently coqc-compiled and re-verified in this session (four report 'Closed under the global context'; the fifth, EQ-015/H.55.v1, correctly has no Print Assumptions output since it has no theorem). Every parent/relates-to citation independently verified against the live registry.
